about: Seed of the MacDriver channel table, from the macspike live checks of 14 Oct 2026 on macOS 26.6 (25G5028f), it-IT. Raw records: docs/probes/2026-10-14.jsonl (personal). Each entry says how to approach an app: which rung worked, which element to use, and the traps. To be replaced by what the living memory learns.
rules: Call only actions the element lists: AXPress on an element without it returns success and does nothing.
Check AXEnabled before pressing a menu item: with the app inactive, commands that need the key window are disabled and AXPress still returns success.
Menu commands that open a new window work with the app inactive (Mail New Message, TextEdit New); commands on the current window do not (Close, New Folder, New Reminder).
Typing: AXMain on the window, AXFocused on the field, then keyboardSetUnicodeString + postToPid. Works with the app behind.
A window title is not a read-back (System Settings Generali has an empty title).
Launch with activates=false; some apps activate themselves anyway (see launch.selfActivates).
First launch often shows an onboarding sheet; dismiss with the non-committal button, never one that migrates data.
Walk only visible rows: Notes, Contacts and Mail have thousands of elements (19 s, 11 s, 104 s for 3000 naive reads).
Irreversible steps (send, delete, pay) go through an adapter with a read-back, never the scene: a GUI send can close its window and deliver nothing.

Commands that need the key window work in background with the seat's preparation (activation record + key-window records 0x01/0x02, as AppKitStatePreparation): the menu item becomes enabled in about 1 s. The activation record alone is not enough. Name the target window in the records.

never: AXPress on the sidebar AXStaticText (false success)
com.apple.systempreferences.readBack: selected sidebar row and a known control of the pane; not the window title
com.apple.systempreferences.notes: Pane content is in the host window's tree (same pid) although the pane runs in an appex process. Aspetto: Automatico/Chiaro/Scuro are AXButton with AXPress.

com.apple.calculator.readBack: AXStaticText display (last one is the result; carries a left-to-right mark)

create: ax:AXFocused on the new row's empty AXTextField
never: menu File > Nuovo promemoria while inactive (disabled)
com.apple.reminders.readBack: smart list button 'Tutti, N promemoria' and the row's AXTextField value
com.apple.reminders.firstRun: prompt 'Passa alla nuova versione': press 'Aggiorna più tardi'

type: events.background:AXMain + AXFocused on the body AXTextArea, postToPid
com.apple.Notes.notes: Main window has 5000+ elements (notes list): walk visible rows only.

compose: events.background:AXFocused on the empty AXTextField after 'A:', type
events.background:AXFocused on the AXTextField after 'Oggetto:', type
send: api:AppleScript make new outgoing message + to recipient + send; read back in sent mailbox by subject and date (verified 14 Oct)
com.apple.mail.readBack: fields: AXTextField values and the web area's AXStaticText; recipient becomes a contact token whose address is not readable; sending: none by AX, needs the Mail adapter's sent mailbox
com.apple.mail.notes: Fields have no labels of their own: the label is the preceding AXStaticText. Viewer window has 3000+ elements (104 s naive).
never: AXPress toolbar 'Invia' with the app inactive: window closed, AXPress said success, the message went to Drafts and was never sent (14 Oct)
menu File > Chiudi or cmd+w while inactive (disabled / ignored)

newFolder: events.background:seat preparation records on the target window, then menu File > Nuova cartella
never: menu File > Nuova cartella while inactive without the key-window records (disabled)
com.apple.finder.notes: Menu is 'File', not 'Archivio', on it-IT 26.6. open -g opens a folder window without activating Finder.
